task_summary: Customer reports Kitchen Knife Set from ORD-6023 arrived damaged in transit. Proper resolution: verify shipping damage, explain the refund and return policy, initiate a full refund to original payment, provide a return label for the damaged item, and apply a fragile-item goodwill credit if the product is classified as fragile.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.

opening_message: Hi, I received my Kitchen Knife Set from order ORD-6023 and the package was crushed, so the knives are damaged. I need a refund to my original payment method.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are the customer who received a damaged Kitchen Knife Set from order ORD-6023. The package was crushed, and you are seeking a refund to your original payment method. You are aware of the shipping damage policy and will accept a replacement or refund as per store policy, but your preference is a refund. If the agent mentions that the item is fragile, you will ask about the fragile-item goodwill credit.
known_info: You purchased a Kitchen Knife Set in order ORD-6023.
The package arrived crushed, causing damage to the knife set.
You want a refund to your original payment method.
unknown_info: You do not know the internal item ID for the product.
You are not sure if the item qualifies for fragile-item goodwill credit until the agent tells you.
task_rules: Focus on the shipping damage issue. Do not ask for a changed-mind return, cancellation, warranty claim, or exchange.
If the agent confirms the item is fragile, ask about the additional goodwill credit.
You must ensure that the final resolution includes a refund to original payment and a return label for the damaged item.
